plan: A phoenix mage who blocks paths with her ice walls and is reborn from her egg.
aSurveiller: Her Q (Flash Frost). It stuns you when it explodes, then her E deals double damage: dodge the orb.
contrer: Dodge her orb (Q): without the stun, her combo hurts much less.
Plan an escape route: her wall (W) can block your path.
When she's in her egg, hit it fast and together so she isn't reborn.
forces: Huge area damage with her R.
faiblesses: Weak at the very start of the game.
Her egg is fragile if hit quickly.

sorts.P: Turns into an egg instead of dying.
sorts.Q: Orb that slows then stuns when it explodes.
sorts.E: Double damage on a chilled target.
sorts.R: Ice storm that slows and grows.

momentFort: Weak early, very dangerous in the mid game.
